// PROBE FIXTURE — not a real route, and deliberately not named `route.ts` so the
// filesystem scan never picks it up. It exists so the claim "the guard reads code,
// not prose" is testable rather than asserted.
//
// Every authorization reference below is a MENTION. Nothing here calls anything.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

/**
 * TODO: call getPolicyAccess(policyId) before returning the document.
 * See lib/policy-access.ts — getPolicyAccess(policyId, userId) is the single path.
 */
export async function GET(_req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
    const { id } = await params

    // This is the bypass the guard must catch: a raw read of an owned table with
    // no authorization at all, wearing a comment that names the right function.
    const rows = await db.$queryRawUnsafe(
        "SELECT * FROM policy_documents WHERE policy_id = $1",
        id
    )

    const note = "authorized via getPolicyAccess(policyId)" // a string, not a call
    return Response.json({ rows, note })
}
